info.title: Decolar Booking API
info.description: API for flight booking process. Includes pre-booking, payment methods, booking confirmation, and reservation management.

choice_id.description: This information is encrypted and must be obtained in the response from the availability service.

lang.description: This field must be filled in with the language in which you wish to receive the information returned in 'extended_info'.

include.description: This field must be submitted with at least one option. The allowed values are:   - EXCHANGE_POLICIES: This option is sent to return information about exchange policies.  - IMPORTANT_DATA: This option is sent to return information about requirements (vaccinations, documentation, etc.) based on the routes and destinations.  - HINTS: This option is sent to return specifications for required fields and formats for billing data.

prebook_id.description: ID automatically generated to identify the flight data and the valid fare to make the booking.

expiration.description: expiration date for the chosen fare.

currency.description: currency corresponding to the returned total amount.

oneOf.title: BAD_REQUEST
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Prebook service executed without sending the 'Authorization' header

message.description: Authorization header is missing.

oneOf.title: INVALID_EXTENDED_INFO_REQUEST
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Prebook executed with 'lang' blank, invalid (including numeric), or not provided in the 'extended_info' structure.

message.description: Invalid or missing 'lang' for extended info

oneOf.title: INVALID_ITINERARY_ID_OR_COUNTRY
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Failure connecting to providers when executing the 'Prebook' service or prebook executed with invalid 'choice_id'

message.description: Invalid itinerary id, country or both

oneOf.title: MESSAGE_NOT_READABLE
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Prebook executed with incorrect body / 'extended_info'

message.description: JSON parse error: Unexpected character ((code 34)): was expecting comma to separate Object entries

JSON parse error: Cannot deserialize value of type com.despegar.ganymede.dto.request.extended.info.ExtendedInfoIncludeEnum from String 'value provided': not one of the values accepted for Enum class; [EXCHANGE_POLICIES, IMPORTANT_DATA, HINTS]

oneOf.title: MISSING_REQUEST_BODY_REQUIRED_FIELD
oneOf.description: possible cause: Prebook executed with blank choice_id

message.description: choiceId should be not null or blank

oneOf.title: PRODUCT_GONE
oneOf.description: Prebook executed with 'choice_id' not found or with expired one

message.description: Product not available.

modality.description: Code that identifies the modality to be used. The only value available at the moment is PAYINADVANCE.

price_information.description: This structure provides price information; it is typically used to display the price in the user interface.

processing_cost.description: payment processing cost; in this total summary it will generally be blank because the cost depends on the number of installments selected.

total.description: Total = Base + Taxes + Fees + Processing Cost - Discount

option_type.description: type of payment option (e.g., ONE_CARD, MULTIPLE_CARD). Currently, the only available option is ONE_CARD.

group_plans.description: payment groups within the payment option.

oneOf.title: ALREADY_BOOKED
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Payments service executed with a previously used 'prebook_id'

message.description: The product was already booked.

oneOf.title: INVALID_FIELD
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Payments service executed with an expired 'prebook_id'

message.description: Invalid value for field 'prebookId'. Expired token

oneOf.title: INVALID_PREBOOK_ID
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Payments service executed with blank or invalid 'prebook_id'

message.description: Invalid identifier format

oneOf.title: MISSING_REQUIRED_PARAMETER
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Payments service executed without parameters or with a 'prebook_id' containing special characters.

message.description: Missing required field 'prebook_id' of type 'String'

oneOf.title: PARAMETER_TYPE_MISMATCH
oneOf.description: Possible cause:Payments service executed with invalid 'include_hints' (type mismatch)

message.description: Invalid value 'value provided' for 'include_hints'. boolean value is required.

parameters.name: test_case
parameters.description: Optional parameter for testing purposes. Use 'pricejump' to simulate a price jump scenario.

prebook_id.description: ID obtained from the prebook response.

first_name.description: Traveler's first name. Required for: FLIGHT, HOTEL, TICKET.

last_name.description: Traveler's last name. Required for: FLIGHT, HOTEL, TICKET.

nationality.description: Traveler's nationality as ISO country code. E.g.: 'br', 'mx'.

birth_date.description: Traveler's date of birth. Format: YYYY-MM-DD.

identification.description: Traveler's identification document. Required for: FLIGHT, TICKET.

type.description: Traveler's document type. Required for: FLIGHT, TICKET.

number.description: Traveler's document number. Required for: FLIGHT, TICKET.

payment.description: Payment information. The 'option_type' field determines which sub-fields are required: CURRENT_ACCOUNT and FULL_POINTS do not include 'payment_units'; ONE_CARD and DEFERRED do.

payment_units.description: Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD or DEFERRED.

type.description: Payment unit type. Use CARD for ONE_CARD, DEFERRED for DEFERRED.

invoice_reference.description: Reference to the corresponding invoice. E.g.: 0.

plan_id.description: Payment plan ID. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD.

secure_token.description: Card secure token. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD.

card_holder_identification.description: Card holder identification. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD.

invoices.description: Buyer fiscal data. Present in all option_type values.

reference.description: Invoice reference. E.g.: 0. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD

first_name.description: First name. Only sent with option_type CURRENT_ACCOUNT

last_name.description: Last name. Only sent with option_type CURRENT_ACCOUNT

type.description: Fiscal document type. Required for: CURRENT_ACCOUNT (all products).

number.description: Fiscal document number. Required for: CURRENT_ACCOUNT (all products).

issue_country.description: Document issuing country. Only sent if fiscal_identification.type is PASSPORT.

street.description: Street name. Required for: CURRENT_ACCOUNT (all products).

neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD AND DEFERRED.

loyalty_data.description: Loyalty program data. Only sent with option_type ONE_CARD.

redemption_points.description: Points to redeem. Send 0 when option_type is ONE_CARD.

oneOf.description: Possible cause: The booking request contains invalid or incomplete data in one or more required fields.

message.description: Authorization header is missing.
Invalid identifier format

oneOf.title: MESSAGE_NOT_READABLE
oneOf.description: Possible cause: The Book request was sent with blank or malformed fields across multiple sections (contact_data.phones.type, travelers.gender/birth_date/identification.type, payment.payment_units.invoice_reference, payment.invoices.reference/fiscal_status, loyalty_data.redemption_points, payment.invoices.fiscal_identification.expiration_date), causing type mismatches, unsupported enum values, and invalid date/number formats.

message.description: JSON parse/validation error - empty, invalid, or unsupported value; wrong type; or malformed date/number (e.g., unsupported enum, alphabetic/numeric where not allowed, incorrect date format).

oneOf.title: PAYMENT_ERROR
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Current account without available balance

message.description: Cannot pay due to current account status.

oneOf.title: PAYMENT_OPTION_NOT_FOUND
oneOf.description: Possible cause: Book executed without sending 'modality' or 'payment -> option_type'

message.description: No payment option found matching criteria: cartId 'cartId', paymentOptionType CURRENT_ACCOUNT

oneOf.title: INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR
oneOf.description: Possible cause: The booking request contains invalid or inconsistent data, including mismatched passenger counts and incomplete required information.
